members.doc: Mocks every subsequent [dynamic import](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Operators/import) call.

members.name: doUnmock
members.doc: Removes module from mocked registry. All subsequent calls to import will return original module.

members.name: importActual
members.doc: Imports module, bypassing all checks if it should be mocked. Can be useful if you want to mock module partially.

members.name: importMock
members.doc: Imports a module with all of its properties and nested properties mocked.

members.name: mockObject
members.doc: Deeply mocks properties and methods of a given object in the same way as `vi.mock()` mocks module exports.

members.name: mocked
members.doc: Type helper for TypeScript. Just returns the object that was passed.

members.name: isMockFunction
members.doc: Checks that a given parameter is a mock function. If you are using TypeScript, it will also narrow down its type.

members.name: clearAllMocks
members.doc: Calls [`.mockClear()`](https://vitest.dev/api/mock#mockclear) on every mocked function.

members.name: resetAllMocks
members.doc: Calls [`.mockReset()`](https://vitest.dev/api/mock#mockreset) on every mocked function.

members.name: restoreAllMocks
members.doc: Calls [`.mockRestore()`](https://vitest.dev/api/mock#mockrestore) on every mocked function.

members.name: stubGlobal
members.type: (name: string | number | symbol, value: unknown) => VitestUtils
members.doc: Makes value available on global namespace. Useful, if you want to have global variables available, like `IntersectionObserver`. You can return it back to original value with `vi.unstubAllGlobals`, or

members.name: stubEnv
members.doc: Changes the value of `import.meta.env` and `process.env`. You can return it back to original value with `vi.unstubAllEnvs`, or by enabling `unstubEnvs` config option.

members.name: unstubAllGlobals
members.doc: Reset the value to original value that was available before first `vi.stubGlobal` was called.

members.name: unstubAllEnvs
members.doc: Reset environmental variables to the ones that were available before first `vi.stubEnv` was called.

members.name: resetModules
members.doc: Resets modules registry by clearing the cache of all modules. This allows modules to be reevaluated when reimported. Top-level imports cannot be re-evaluated. Might be useful to isolate modules where

members.name: dynamicImportSettled
members.doc: Wait for all imports to load. Useful, if you have a synchronous call that starts importing a module that you cannot await otherwise. Will also wait for new imports, started during the wait.

members.name: setConfig
members.doc: Updates runtime config. You can only change values that are used when executing tests.

members.name: resetConfig
members.doc: If config was changed with `vi.setConfig`, this will reset it to the original state().
